paper_title: Deepest sensitivity to wavelike dark photon dark matter with superconducting radio frequency cavities
notes: Proof-of-concept dark photon DM search with a nontunable 1.3 GHz SRF cavity (QL=4.7e9) at Fermilab SQMS (SERAPH phase 1). Measured 90% CL exclusion chi > 1.5e-16 at m_A' = 5.354 ueV (f0 = 1.294605478 GHz). The exclusion is extremely narrow-band (a few kHz / ~15 peV around the resonance, per Fig. 3); the emitted points bracket that narrow range at the on-resonance limit value. Assumes randomly polarized dark photon, SHM line shape, rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3.
